intervention.DE: add alpha times the selected semantic delta to one native best-target trial vector
intervention.PSO: add alpha times the selected semantic delta to one native global-best velocity

pairing: same reconstructed state, continuation seed, and numerical budget
selection_rule: Among passing alphas choose lowest negative-transfer rate, then lowest mean relative change, then the smallest alpha.
stopping_rule: Execute all instances 1--13 and all three alphas without early stopping.
future_boundary: Do not capture instances 14--21 unless at least one backbone-alpha pair passes every gate.
